name: Birdwatcher Tobias

intro.text: Curlews on the moor, lapwings in the meadow, peregrines on the crag. I keep a list. It's a long list, but a quiet one.

win: You've got a good eye. Better than mine, and I have binoculars.
after: A curlew's call is the sound of the moors. I'd call it back, but I'd be wrong in every way.
